integrity: Scientific proof and independently generated finite arithmetic/graph checks are included; no external or independent mathematical audit has been performed. No author or priority attribution is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Rank-two Grassmann graphs in pure adjacency/equality with counting-free FO^3 only; no result for higher variables, higher-rank subspaces, edge deletions or numbers of distinct minimum deletion sets. Mathematical argument is uniform in prime powers; finite checker covers q=2,3 and formula diagnostics elsewhere. Historical priority is provisional; full text of Bonato--Cameron 2001 was unavailable.
title: Exact three-variable deletion resilience of rank-two Grassmann graphs
